topic: Ecosystem MCP 2026 (registry, awesome repos, popularne serwery)

claims.claim: Na 2026-04-17 istnieje ~5,000+ community MCP servers.
Oficjalny Anthropic MCP Registry endpoint: https://api.anthropic.com/mcp-registry/v0/servers z filtrem worksWith (claude-code/claude-api/claude-desktop).
Anthropic Registry ma 'commercial visibility' flag - verified quality. OSS servers partially self-publish.
Oficjalny repo reference implementations: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers (filesystem, memory, sqlite, time, fetch, puppeteer DEPRECATED, sequential-thinking).
Top community awesome-mcp repos: wong2/awesome-mcp-servers (najwiekszy), appcypher/awesome-mcp-servers, punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers, YuzeHao2023/Awesome-MCP-Servers.
Top 15 servers 2026 (core utilities): Filesystem, Memory, Sequential Thinking, Fetch.
Top 15 developer tools: GitHub, Git, Playwright (zastepuje DEPRECATED Puppeteer), Docker.
Top 15 data sources: Postgres (top-3 enterprise), SQLite, Brave Search, Firecrawl.
Top 15 productivity/SaaS: Slack, Gmail (via Rube), Google Drive (via Rube albo bezposredni).
Puppeteer MCP DEPRECATED - oficjalne migracja do Playwright MCP (Microsoft-managed) - cross-browser support.
Aggregatory 2026: Rube (500+ apps), Apify Actors MCP (2000+ scrapers), Bright Data.
Minimalist trio 75% uzytkownikow: GitHub + Filesystem + Memory.
Research/Content trio: Brave Search or Firecrawl + Memory + GitHub.
Data analyst trio: Postgres/SQLite + Memory + Filesystem.
Full-stack combo (5-7 servers): GitHub + Filesystem + Playwright + Postgres + Vercel + Slack + Memory.
Quality signals: stars (1k+ oficjalne, 100+ community high-quality), last commit recency (<6mo), tests w CI, Docker support, OAuth 2.1, OpenTelemetry, official SDK use.
Trust hierarchy: official Anthropic > Microsoft/HashiCorp/commercial > individual maintainer.
Gdzie odkrywac: mcp.so, mcpservers.org, glama.ai, r/mcp Reddit, Twitter #MCP, Anthropic blog, HN 'Show HN: MCP X'.
Trendy 2026: aggregators dominuja new installs, remote > local shift, OAuth 2.1 standardyzacja, multi-tenant servers dla enterprise, OpenTelemetry adoption, post-CVE security audyty.
Instalacja patterns: npx (TS), pip (Python), docker run (containerized), claude mcp add --transport http (remote).
Enterprise recommendation: tylko z Anthropic Registry + internal gateway. Personal: awesome-mcp ok, z scrutiny.

Categorizacja use-case: Code (GitHub, Filesystem), Data (Postgres, MongoDB), Comm (Slack, Gmail), Calendar (Linear, Jira), Web (Brave, Firecrawl), Browser (Playwright), DevOps (Docker, K8s), Enterprise agg (Rube, Apify).

conflicts_flagged: R4.C1 (~5000 community servers) - szacowanie oparte na wielu sources, exact number nieweryfikowalne bez formalnego count. Flag 'approximate 2026-04-17'.
R4.C11 (Rube/Apify aggregatory) vs R6 token budget - aggregatory mogą eksplodować tool definitions jesli nie maja Tool Search Tool. Brak konfliktu ale interakcja wazna.
R4.C10 (Puppeteer deprecated, migracja na Playwright) - mowią sources, ale dokladna data deprecacji + exact comm nie w disclosure. Worth naming 'recommended migration' not 'mandatory'.

Lista server deprecations na 2026-04-17 wymaga per-server audit - mozliwe ze wiecej niz tylko Puppeteer.
Managed MCP enterprise deploy case studies rzadkie publicznie - enterprise podejrzewa sa ale nie publikowane.
